create_autoencoder_kl: create an AutoencoderKL instance with FluxVAEConfig for encoding images into latents and decoding latents back to images
encode_images_to_latents: encode a batch of images into latent representations using the encode method with optional slicing and tiling
decode_latents_to_images: decode a batch of latent vectors back into images using the decode method with optional slicing
enable_tiled_vae_decoding: enable tiled VAE decoding to split large images into overlapping tiles for memory-efficient encoding and decoding
fuse_qkv_projections: fuse QKV projections on all attention modules to enable FusedAttnProcessor2_0 for faster inference
